description: Notra is a generative engine optimization and content operations product that tracks how AI answer engines mention a brand, attributes AI-agent traffic, and helps teams turn content gaps and shipped work into drafts like articles, changelogs, and social posts.
summary: Notra exposes a public HTTP API at api.usenotra.com, a hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server at mcp.usenotra.com, and an npm-distributed `notra` CLI; the API and MCP accept bearer API keys and OAuth tokens, while the CLI supports browser/device OAuth login and API-key-based automation.
